on_screen_text: English Seekho, INSTALL NOW, [Disclaimer text stating English Seekho is not affiliated with any government authority or brand, and results depend on individual effort.]
summary: An animated narrative about Sanjeev, a construction worker who misses a promotion because he cannot speak English. After using the 'English Seekho' app's 1-rupee trial to practice with an AI coach, he successfully communicates with a foreign engineer, gets promoted, and doubles his salary.
